display_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the three stored per-seed summaries; authoritative gated aggregate estimates/uncertainty are retained unchanged in DECISION.json. Tiny float32-versus-float64 rounding differences are not new decisions.
gradient_scope: 16 empirical fixed-training-batch estimates per selected C model; zero observed variance is not evidence that true rare-event variance is zero. No optimizer update.
counterfactual_field_semantics: See EVALUATION_FIELD_SEMANTICS.md; retained base descendant/loss_per_example fields are not counterfactual objective values.
